thread:
sylvia: I published the RCA for this morning's policy-change incident. Internal doc: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/pm/1864201111 (internal only).
infra-bot: Postmortem uploaded — timeline, root cause, mitigation steps and attachments are in the doc. :robot_face:
marc: Quick executive summary for leadership: a late policy toggle inadvertently widened routing to experimental pools; those pools lacked the updated batching knobs, which drove token-queueing and transient 503s for ~20 minutes. No PII exposure.
ceo-karim: Thanks. Please attach a one-paragraph board-facing blurb and include estimated customer impact numbers.
sylvia: Done. Copying the action table from the doc below — owners, short due dates. Please ACK and update your ETA inline in the doc.
```
- PACT-1 | Owner: marc       | Revert policy toggle and add policy-change feature-flag gating in CI | Due: 2026-03-31
- PACT-2 | Owner: sylvia     | Add pre-deploy policy smoke tests and an automated diff check | Due: 2026-04-02
- PACT-3 | Owner: oncall     | Add alert for unexpected policy expansion and page on trigger | Due: 2026-03-29
- PACT-4 | Owner: product    | Update internal policy-change playbook + add customer-impact template | Due: 2026-04-06
- PACT-5 | Owner: cs         | Prepare proactive customer communications for impacted tenants | Due: 2026-03-30
- CHECKPOINT | All owners     | Post a brief status update in the doc by EOD 2026-03-27
```
oncall: I will add the alert and paging rule. Will verify in staging and tag oncall when enabled.
cs: Drafting the customer note now; will request legal review once ready.
marc: Revert applied for the risky toggle and rolling patched configs to canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood/control-plane/pull/6110
infra-bot: Follow-up checkpoint calendar invite created: 2026-04-14 10:00 PT. Invite sent to owners. :calendar:
product: I've added the playbook entry and a short template for customer comms. Will loop in docs for a final pass.
ceo-karim: Appreciate the quick containment. Keep me posted if we see any repeated policy churn across teams.
sylvia: Thanks everyone. If you can’t make the April 14 checkpoint, leave a short written update in the doc beforehand. We’ll use that meeting to confirm closure of PACT items. :white_check_mark:
